name: Build a modern, minimal, single-page personal

messages.content:
Build a modern, minimal, single-page personal portfolio website for
Jasil KJ, a first-year B.Tech CSE (AI) student at Thejus Engineering
College, Thrissur, Kerala.

DESIGN REFERENCE
Dark, futuristic tech-conference style: near-black navy background
(#0a0a1a), purple-to-blue gradient accents (#8b5cf6 → #3b82f6),
glassmorphism cards (translucent bg, subtle 1px border, soft glow),
rounded corners (16px), generous spacing, clean sans-serif typography
(Inter or Space Grotesk), large bold hero heading with one gradient
word. Keep the overall look simple, uncluttered and professional.

TECH STACK
HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (or React + Tailwind if preferred).
Fully responsive (mobile-first), fast, no heavy libraries.

SECTIONS
1. Sticky navbar: logo "JASIL", links (Home, About, Skills, Projects,
   Contact), gradient "Hire Me" / "Contact" button. Collapses to a
   hamburger on mobile.
2. Hero: small tag "B.Tech CSE (AI) • Thejus Engineering College",
   big headline "Building the Future with <gradient>AI & Code</gradient>",
   short intro line, two buttons (View Projects, Download Resume),
   and a profile photo/illustration placeholder on the right with a
   soft purple glow.
3. Stats row (4 glass cards): Year 1 B.Tech | Projects Built |
   Languages Learned | Certifications — easy to edit, animated
   count-up on scroll.
4. About: short paragraph on my background, interests (AI, ML,
   web dev), and goals, with a glass card layout.
5. Skills: grid of glass cards with icons (Python, C, HTML/CSS,
   JavaScript, Git, basic ML, etc.) and optional progress/level tags.
6. Projects: 3 placeholder project cards (image, title, description,
   tech tags, GitHub + Live links) with hover lift and glow.
7. Education/Timeline: simple vertical timeline (Thejus Engineering
   College, Thrissur – B.Tech CSE (AI), 2025–2029; school details).
8. Contact: form (name, email, message) + social links (GitHub,
   LinkedIn, Email, Instagram).
9. Footer: copyright, back-to-top button.

UX / INTERACTIONS
- Smooth scrolling and active-link highlighting
- Subtle fade-in/slide-up animations on scroll
- Hover glow on cards and buttons
- Animated gradient blob or soft grid in the hero background
- Dark theme only, accessible contrast, semantic HTML, good SEO meta
  tags, favicon

CODE QUALITY
- Clean folder structure (index.html, style.css, script.js, assets/)
- CSS variables for colors and fonts so the theme is easy to change
- Well-commented code, placeholder content clearly marked for me to
  replace
- Deployable on GitHub Pages / Netlify

Start by generating the full project, then explain how to run it
and where to edit my details.
